summary: A revival site for an 1885 patented stencil face: a narrow, serif-set scholarly article (history, the full patent text, a bibliography) in Dapifer and Mercantile, punctuated by two editable three-line lockups in the display face. A small fixed scroll-spy and a minimal on-page price selector with EULA gate frame it.

instances.look: Centred Victorian title stack on cream: small ornament, 'STENCIL-GOTHIC', a much larger 'OXYMORON', 'APTITUDE 1885', and a stencil arrow pointing down
instances.feel: A 19th-century specimen sheet that is quietly joking
instances.ux: Arrow suggests scrolling; a fixed nav and a logo stamp sit in the bottom corners
instances.learn: Pick words that describe the design as period specimen copy: 'Oxymoron Aptitude 1885' is a joke, a date and a brief in three lines

reconstruction.layout: Full width, ~704px tall (78vh); centred stack; ornament rule ~120px wide at y≈110; lines at 2:5:2 scale; arrow at y≈640. First paragraph of the essay peeks at the fold
reconstruction.typography: 'Stencil-Gothic' and 'Aptitude 1885': ~64px; 'Oxymoron': 160px; all Stencil-Gothic Regular (caps-only font), #1d1c1a-ish on cream, centred
reconstruction.assets: Ornament rule (font glyph or image), round logo stamp bottom right
reconstruction.html: header > p.sten_goth.medium_size, h1.sten_goth.small_size, p.sten_goth.big_size.centered, p.small_size.extra, p '↓'

instances.learn: Tiny fixed nav in a corner keeps a long article scholarly; a reversed bar is enough to mark the current chapter

instances.look: Two centred three-line lockups interrupting the essay ('Quizzicality of / John West, / Hybrid Expert' and 'South Brooklyn / 123 Test / Flower Market'), middle line larger, with no visible controls

instances.learn: Plant the word 'Test' in an editable lockup: the sample is its own instruction, and the three-size hierarchy keeps anything typed looking composed

instances.learn: One select, one price, one tick: a one-product checkout needs no cart. Gating the pay link on the EULA makes the licence the last thing read
